reply_text:
I saved the draft to Hollis and replied to Anselm in the DM.

- **Draft:** It's addressed to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com, Central team lead) with the subject "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,356/seat figure, names Dana Okafor as the source and says Anselm approved sharing it. It hasn't been sent; someone has to review and send it.
- **Why this was allowed:** Hollis doesn't own Quarrendon Freight Lines (Dana does), so the rate normally needs approval from Anselm or June before it can go to Hollis. Anselm is the CFO and gave that approval in his own message, and the address is inside pemberline.com, so I didn't need to ask anyone else.

GBrain search ran in keyword-only mode. It found no other notes on this rate, but in that mode it can miss notes that word things differently.
